comment: Plastic Feature's lip and boss options of mitcad#2511 (tools/ui-plastic-drafts-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins): an 80 x 50 x 30 box (Box1 F1, Body1 F1.b0) shelled 6 thick through its top (Shell1 F2): 57984 mm3, its rim F2:offset_cap(F1:top) wide enough to click; a 60 x 60 x 3 plate from (100, 0) (Box2 F3, Body2 F3.b0) with a wall 10 thick along its far edge, 15 above it (Box3 F4, joined): 19800 mm3.
